description: Election Commission - Declare that P. Sudaharan as a member of the Haldummulla Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Haldummulla Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes at the local authority level, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement through established electoral procedures. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
